items.title: # Explain Code Logic
items.content: Explain the following [programming language] code snippet step-by-step for a [beginner/intermediate] developer. Focus on its purpose and functionality. Code: [Paste Code Here]

items.title: # Generate Code Snippet
items.content: Write a [programming language] function that [describe functionality, e.g., sorts an array of numbers]. Include example usage, comments, and handle common edge cases.

items.title: # Debug My Code
items.content: Identify and fix any bugs in this [programming language] code. Explain the errors clearly and provide the corrected code. Code: [Paste Code Here]

items.title: # Refactor For Clarity
items.content: Refactor the following [programming language] code to improve readability and efficiency, without changing its core functionality. Explain your changes. Code: [Paste Code Here]

items.title: # Structure Your Talk
items.content: Create a detailed presentation outline on [Topic] for a [Audience] that includes an introduction, 3 main points with sub-bullets, and a conclusion. Suggest visuals for each section.

items.title: # Draft Slide Content
items.content: Generate content for 5 slides about [Specific Aspect of Topic]. Each slide should have a title, 3-4 bullet points, and a brief speaker note. Target a [Time] minute segment for [Audience].

items.title: # Prepare Q and A
items.content: Based on a presentation about [Topic] for [Audience], list 5 potential challenging questions and provide concise, expert answers for each. Focus on common concerns or misunderstandings.

items.title: # Boost Audience Engagement
items.content: Suggest a captivating opening hook and a memorable closing statement for a presentation on [Topic] to [Audience]. Include a short anecdote or relatable example for the introduction.

items.title: # Quick Meeting Recap
items.content: Summarize the following meeting transcript into 3-5 key bullet points, including any action items and owners. Transcript: [Paste meeting transcript here]

items.title: # Audience Specific Summary
items.content: Summarize the key decisions and next steps from this meeting transcript for a [Audience, e.g., executive, technical team] audience. Transcript: [Paste meeting transcript here]

items.title: # Decisions Next Steps
items.content: Extract all decisions made and identified next steps from the following meeting transcript. List them clearly with responsible parties and deadlines if mentioned. Transcript: [Paste transcript]

items.title: # Key Discussion Points
items.content: Analyze the following meeting transcript and identify the top 3-5 most important discussion points and any unresolved questions. Present as bullet points. Transcript: [Paste transcript]

items.title: # Address Common Issues
items.content: Draft a polite and helpful customer support reply addressing a common issue with [Product/Service] regarding [Specific Problem]. Focus on empathy and providing a clear solution.

items.title: # Thank Happy Customers
items.content: Write a warm and appreciative customer support response to a positive review about [Product/Service] from [Customer Name/User ID]. Encourage continued engagement.

items.title: # Manage Refund Requests
items.content: Generate a customer support email for a refund request for [Product/Service]. State the policy clearly, offer alternatives if possible, and maintain a respectful tone.

items.title: # Explain Service Delays
items.content: Create a concise customer support message explaining a recent service delay or outage for [Product/Service]. Apologize, state the impact, and provide an estimated resolution time if known.

items.title: # Launch New Product
items.content: Generate a marketing campaign for [Product/Service] targeting [Audience] to achieve [Goal]. Suggest 3 channels and core messages.

items.title: # Social Media Strategy
items.content: Develop a social media campaign for [Company Name] to increase engagement among [Target Demographic]. Provide 3 platform-specific content ideas for [Platform].

items.title: # Lead Generation Funnel
items.content: Create a lead generation campaign for [Industry] focusing on [Specific Product/Service]. Outline 3 actionable strategies to attract and convert new prospects.

items.title: # Customer Retention Plan
items.content: Design a customer retention campaign for [Business Type] to improve loyalty. Suggest 3 personalized communication ideas and a simple loyalty program concept.

items.title: # Marketing Tactic Breakdown
items.content: Analyze [Competitor Name]'s marketing for [Product/Service]. Identify key channels, messaging, and target audience. List strengths and weaknesses.

items.title: # SWOT Competitor Analysis
items.content: Perform a SWOT analysis for [Competitor Name] regarding their [Product/Service]. Focus on their current market position and recent activities.

items.title: # Feature Comparison Grid
items.content: Create a feature comparison table between our [Product Name] and [Competitor Product Name]. Include [3-5 Key Features] and highlight differences.

items.title: # Pricing Strategy Deepdive
items.content: Describe the pricing strategy of [Competitor Name] for their [Product/Service]. Include pricing tiers, discounts, and value propositions. Suggest potential counter-strategies.

items.title: # Analyze Competitors Fast
items.content: Identify [Number] key competitors for [Product/Service] in the [Industry] market. For each, list their strengths, weaknesses, target audience, and unique selling propositions.

items.title: # Create Buyer Persona
items.content: Develop a detailed buyer persona for [Product/Service]. Include demographic info, goals, pain points, preferred communication channels, and how [Product/Service] addresses their needs.

items.title: # Spot Market Trends
items.content: List the top 5 emerging market trends in the [Industry] sector. Explain how each trend could impact businesses and suggest potential opportunities for [Your Company/Product].

items.title: # Gather Product Feedback
items.content: Design a survey with 5 open-ended questions to gather feedback on [Product Feature/New Idea] from [Target Audience]. Focus on usability, value, and areas for improvement.
